title: Do not pipe downloaded content directly to a shell
why: Executing a network response without inspecting or verifying it turns transport, hosting, and content compromise into immediate code execution.
suggestion: Download to a file, verify its expected digest or signature, inspect it when appropriate, and then execute the verified file.
limitations: Detection covers curl and wget pipelines to common POSIX shell interpreters.
The rule does not establish whether the downloaded content is cryptographically trusted.
